topic: The deepest point of the ocean
hook_candidates: Drop Mount Everest here and it would still be underwater.
Fewer people have been here than to the Moon.
The pressure down here would crush you like a soda can.

scenes.narration: Drop Mount Everest here and it would still be underwater.
This is the Challenger Deep, at the bottom of the Mariana Trench.
It's almost eleven kilometers down, deeper than Everest is tall.
The water pushes on you with over 1,000 times the air pressure.
That's like an elephant standing on your thumbnail.
Sunlight dies after a few hundred meters, so it's pitch black.
But something still lives down there.
Tiny shrimp-like amphipods, and fish made of almost jelly.
Fewer people have reached this spot than have walked on the Moon.
And here's the scary part: scientists found plastic bags there too.

title: Everest would DISAPPEAR down here 🌊
description:
The Challenger Deep is the deepest place on Earth.
And humans still left trash there.
